solver_sql: WITH j AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM appearances a INNER JOIN player p ON CAST(p.player_id AS TEXT) = CAST(a.player_id AS TEXT) GROUP BY p.bats), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS T FROM j), b AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS B FROM j WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL) SELECT j.bats, j.cnt, CAST(j.cnt AS REAL) / t.T AS share, CAST(j.cnt AS REAL) / b.B AS ratio FROM j INNER JOIN b ON b.B IS NOT NULL CROSS JOIN t

WITH g AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS S FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON CAST(p.player_id AS TEXT) = CAST(a.player_id AS TEXT) GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), t AS (SELECT AVG(S) AS T FROM g WHERE S IS NOT NULL) SELECT SUM(g.S) AS total_S, AVG(g.S - t.T) AS avg_diff FROM g JOIN t ON t.T IS NOT NULL WHERE g.S > t.T

SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS ratio FROM film_actor fa JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY f.rating HAVING SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () IS NOT NULL

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS v FROM film GROUP BY rating), o AS (SELECT AVG(v) AS ov FROM r WHERE v IS NOT NULL) SELECT o.ov AS avg_value, AVG(r.v - o.ov) AS avg_diff FROM r JOIN o ON o.ov IS NOT NULL WHERE r.v > o.ov

WITH a AS (SELECT o.order_id, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity),'') AS REAL)) AS A FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), b AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM a) SELECT a.order_id, a.A, a.A - b.B AS diff FROM a CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.B IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS u, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS D FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON CAST(pc.production_type_code AS TEXT) = CAST(p.production_type_code AS TEXT) GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), e AS (SELECT AVG(D) AS E FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.u) AS avg_units, AVG(g.D) AS avg_D, AVG(g.D - e.E) AS avg_D_minus_E FROM g JOIN e ON e.E IS NOT NULL WHERE g.D > e.E

WITH g AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id AS oid, c.town_city AS town, AVG(ili.product_price) AS gp, AVG(1.0*ili.derived_product_cost/ili.derived_total_cost) AS gr FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city), t AS (SELECT town, AVG(gp) AS P, AVG(gr) AS R FROM g GROUP BY town), q AS (SELECT AVG(P) AS Q FROM t) SELECT t.town, t.P, t.R, t.P - q.Q AS diff FROM t JOIN q ON q.Q IS NOT NULL WHERE t.P > q.Q

WITH g AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, AVG(l.derived_product_cost) AS X, AVG(l.derived_total_cost * 1.0 / p.unit_price) AS Y FROM Invoice_Line_Items l JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), t AS (SELECT AVG(Y) AS T FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.X) AS avg_X, AVG(g.Y) AS avg_Y, AVG(g.Y - t.T) AS avg_Y_minus_T FROM g, t WHERE g.Y > t.T

WITH per AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS o FROM per) SELECT AVG(per.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avgs, AVG(per.n) AS avg_track_count, AVG(per.avg_ratio - overall.o) AS avg_diff FROM per, overall WHERE per.avg_ratio > overall.o

WITH g AS (SELECT SupportRepId, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customer GROUP BY SupportRepId), t AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS tot FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.n * 1.0 / t.tot AS share FROM g, t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM s) SELECT (SELECT tot FROM t) AS total_n, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.av) AS avg_diff FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.av

WITH g AS (SELECT b.link_to_event AS ev, e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS a FROM budget b JOIN event e ON CAST(e.event_id AS TEXT) = CAST(b.link_to_event AS TEXT) GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type), t AS (SELECT type, AVG(a) AS ta FROM g GROUP BY type), G AS (SELECT AVG(ta) AS gv FROM t) SELECT t.type, t.ta, t.ta / G.gv FROM t, G WHERE t.ta IS NOT NULL AND G.gv IS NOT NULL

WITH s1 AS (SELECT L.ID AS id, P.SEX AS sex, AVG(L.WBC) AS c3, AVG(L.HGB / (L.HCT / 100.0)) AS c4 FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID GROUP BY L.ID, P.SEX), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c4) AS b FROM s1) SELECT s1.id, s1.sex, s1.c3, s1.c4, s1.c4 - s2.b AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.b IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c4 > s2.b ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

WITH s1 AS (SELECT ID AS c1, AVG(PIC) AS c2, AVG(HGB / (NULLIF(HCT,0) / 100.0)) AS c3 FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c3) AS c1 FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c3 AS c3, s1.c3 - s2.c1 AS c4 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.c1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c3 > s2.c1) SELECT AVG(c2) AS avg_c2, AVG(c3) AS avg_c3, AVG(c4) AS avg_c4 FROM s3

WITH p AS (SELECT l.ID, pt.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS a3, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS a4 FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient pt ON pt.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, pt.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(a3) AS s3, AVG(a4) AS s4 FROM p GROUP BY SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(s3) AS M FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.SEX, s.s3, s.s4, s.s3 - m.M AS d FROM s, m WHERE s.s3 > m.M) SELECT AVG(s3), AVG(s4), AVG(d) FROM k

WITH c AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS T FROM c), r AS (SELECT c.ID, c.cnt, c.cnt*1.0/t.T AS ratio FROM c, t), m AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS M FROM r WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(r.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(r.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(r.ratio - m.M) AS avg_diff FROM r JOIN m ON r.ratio > m.M

WITH g AS (SELECT cs.raceId AS raceId, c.country AS country, AVG(cs.points) AS ap, AVG(cs.wins) AS aw FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cs.raceId, c.country), a AS (SELECT country, AVG(ap) AS A, AVG(aw) AS W FROM g GROUP BY country), b AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM a) SELECT a.country, a.A, a.W, a.A - b.B AS diff FROM a JOIN b ON b.B IS NOT NULL

WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS h, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS grp_avg FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON CAST(s.zoneregistry AS TEXT) = CAST(sc.zoneref AS TEXT) GROUP BY s.healtheval), G AS (SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS gavg FROM g) SELECT g.h AS healtheval, g.total_scans, g.grp_avg, g.grp_avg - G.gavg AS diff FROM g JOIN G ON G.gavg IS NOT NULL WHERE g.grp_avg > G.gavg

WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS h, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS a, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON CAST(s.zoneregistry AS TEXT) = CAST(sc.zoneref AS TEXT) GROUP BY s.healtheval), G AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS gm FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.a) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(g.n) AS avg_count, AVG(g.a - G.gm) AS avg_diff FROM g JOIN G ON G.gm IS NOT NULL WHERE g.a > G.gm

WITH c AS (SELECT ordervault, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin WHERE ordervault IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordervault), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS T FROM c), r AS (SELECT c.ordervault, c.cnt, c.cnt*1.0/t.T AS R FROM c JOIN t ON t.T IS NOT NULL), y AS (SELECT AVG(R) AS Y FROM r), k AS (SELECT r.cnt, r.R, r.R - y.Y AS D, y.Y FROM r JOIN y ON y.Y IS NOT NULL WHERE r.R > y.Y) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(R) AS avg_R, AVG(D) AS avg_D FROM k
